source.stem:
Plant cells are often green but animal cells are not usually green.
Which structure in plant cells makes them green?

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Alveoli can transfer oxygen into blood even when no blood vessels run beside them.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Carbon dioxide passes from alveoli into blood, and oxygen passes from blood into alveoli.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The windpipe transfers oxygen from its air into blood and receives carbon dioxide from blood.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: Fresh air flows as a whole from the alveoli into the blood vessels.

intelligence.enrichment: Fresh air fills the alveoli; their thin walls are surrounded by blood tubes, so oxygen from alveolar air passes into blood and carbon dioxide carried by blood passes into the alveoli to be breathed out. fresh air reaches alveoli + blood reaches alveolar walls -> oxygen enters blood and carbon dioxide enters alveoli -> gases are transported or exhaled The learner correctly applies this rule: Fresh air fills the alveoli; their thin walls are surrounded by blood tubes, so oxygen from alveolar air passes into blood and carbon dioxide carried by blood passes into the alveoli to be breathed out. Air enters the lungs and directly becomes blood without a gas exchange step.
